about: Acceptance items vectors. AcceptanceItems.java and acceptance-items.ts must give exactly these item texts (whitespace-normalized). Items = list items (numbered '1.' / '1)' or bulleted '-' '*' '+') directly under the FIRST heading whose text contains 'acceptance' (case-insensitive), up to the next heading of the same or higher level. Nested (indented) items belong to their parent and are not separate items. keySame: pairs whose keys must be equal; keyDiffer: pairs whose keys must differ. Key = lowercase hex SHA-256 of the normalized text (trimmed, internal whitespace runs collapsed to one space).
